connector.name: OpenAgenda by openagenda.com
connector.registryDescription: Search, analyze and manage events on OpenAgenda.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.openagenda.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.openagenda, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OA_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAgenda API key (the stdio credential — a least-privilege/read key is advised). The hosted remote uses OAuth instead.

env.name: OA_BASE_URL
env.description: v3 API base URL (defaults to https://api.openagenda.com/v3).

env.name: OA_EXECUTOR
env.description: Code engine: node (default — Node's permission sandbox: no filesystem/subprocess; network NOT bounded) or deno (adds a scoped network egress boundary; recommended hardening, needs deno installed).

env.name: OA_LOCAL_NO_SANDBOX
env.description: Disable the Node permission sandbox entirely (bare node, NO boundary at all) — trusted/dev use only.
